outfit_description: Cream long-sleeve cotton blouse with a modest small rounded collar, very fine lace edging and lightly gathered sleeves ending in neat cuffs. Over it, a warm cocoa-brown pinafore dress with broad straps, a softly square neckline, two small covered buttons near the bodice, a natural waist and an elegant gently flared skirt ending just above the knees. Soft brushed woven fabric, not stiff overalls and not an apron. Ivory / warm off-white knee-high rib-knit socks with simple neat ribbed cuffs. The cream blouse and socks harmonize against the cocoa dress. Gentle relaxed standing pose with shoulders easy, head tilted only slightly, hands loosely resting together at the natural waist so the dress shape and both sleeves remain visible. Both feet grounded, one slightly forward. Charming and softly classic, like trying a new outfit at home.
